# SMAA

Enhanced Subpixel Morphological Antialiasing, by Jorge Jimenez, Jose I. Echevarria, Belen Masia,
Fernando Navarro and Diego Gutierrez. MIT license (`LICENSE.txt`).

- Source: https://github.com/iryoku/smaa (official repository), commit
  `71c806a838bdd7d517df19192a20f0c61b3ca29d` (2013-11-06), the latest.
- `SMAA.hlsl`: unchanged. `SMAA.hlsl.inc`: the same text as a C++ string, generated by
  `tools/embed_smaa.py` (non-ASCII characters of the comments become `?`).
- `AreaTex.h`, `SearchTex.h`: unchanged (from `Textures/`), the precomputed lookup textures.

Used by `runtime/gpu/smaa.cpp` (video.antialiasing = "smaa"): SMAA 1x, luma edge detection,
preset HIGH, on the final image at the internal resolution.
